messages:
maria: dropped a short RFC addendum about fallback semantics when an appliance fails post-activate in an air-gapped site. link: https://rfc.redwood.local/r/onprem-fallbacks - pls skim.

maria: core problem: if activation flips runtime ABI (cuda->cpu, or quant change) and something dies, how do we safely recover without operator needing cloud access?

herrera: my take: make activation idempotent and reversible locally. keep a pre-activation snapshot (small metadata+symlink plan) and do activation as a single atomic symlink swap. if health checks fail within N seconds, operator auto-rolls back.

liam: question: snapshots for 100+GB model dirs are expensive. we can't copy the whole model. propose storing a lightweight activation manifest: list of moved files + new symlink targets, and an apply journal so rollback replays reverse ops.

maria: exactly. activation journal approach avoids full copies. journal format in RFC: newline-delimited ops with sha256 checks.

herrera: and what about partial delta installs? if a delta leaves blob X missing and activation swaps symlink, rollback must detect missing chunks and prefer to keep old symlink until verify completes.

liam: operator behavior: 1) staged-download 2) verify-sample 3) mark ready 4) require admin-ack if unsafe_changes 5) swap symlink atomically 6) short grace probe window (default 120s) then finalize.

maria: add console flag to change grace window per-tenant. offline sites often need longer windows.

ops-bot: note: telemetry event schema v1.4 registered: apply.start, apply.journal_write, apply.activate, apply.rollback, verify.sample, verify.background_complete. :white_check_mark:

herrera: logging example I pasted in RFC patch: 
```
[apply.start] id=20260315-51 manifest=sha256:7f3a size=210GB mode=delta
[journal:write] entries=472 bytes=14MB
[activate] result=pending grace=120s
[health:probe] url=http://localhost:8080/ready code=503
[rollback] reason=health-failure duration=42s
```

liam: operator API quick example (RFC):
```bash
# request apply with admin ack token if needed
curl -X POST \'http://local-op/api/v1/apply\' -d '{"manifest":"sha256:7f3a","options":{"admin_ack":"token-xyz","grace":300}}'
```

maria: compatibility note: operator v1.0 only understands schema v1.0 manifests; we plan a schema extension v1.1 for chunked deltas and signer-chain. operator will accept fallback full bundles when unknown fields present. update matrix in RFC.

herrera: security: signer-chain file must include signer id + certs and a local CA bundle path configurable on the appliance. offline rotation handled by providing new signer certs in a special "escrow" directory prior to apply.

liam: perf: manifest verification for big model sets is heavy. RFC suggests sample-then-bg-verify model and expose status="partial" to control-plane when finished. also emit a metric apply.verify_seconds and apply.unverified_chunks_count.

maria: ops followup: ask SRE to define alert threshold: if any appliance has unverified_chunks_count > 0 for >24h, trigger P2. we'll put that in runbook. @herrera can you draft runbook steps for abort vs manual-retry?

herrera: yep will add a short runbook: check journal, check chunk store, manual-rollback curl, escalate if hardware issue.

ops-bot: reminder: please add reviewer tags on RFC: maria, herrera, liam. auto-snooze in 48h. :bell:

maria: thanks all. I'll update the RFC with the journal format, sample logs, and the operator API examples tomorrow. feedback welcome on whether journal ops should be binary diffs or simple file-move records.
